fact: 1914年12月18日，英国宣布埃及为保护国，废黜正在国外的赫迪夫阿拔斯·希勒米，改立侯赛因·卡米勒为苏丹。1914年11月2日英国已在埃及宣布戒严。埃及名义上仍是奥斯曼帝国的一部分，实际行政与防务由英国控制。

sources.title: Away from the Western Front, Egypt
sources.quote: On 2 November, the British declared Martial Law in Egypt, where troops had already begun pouring in to defend the country and the Canal. On 5 November the British declared war on the Ottomans, and on 18 December 1914 declared Egypt to be a Protectorate.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Raid on the Suez Canal
sources.quote: Abbas Hilmi, the reigning Khedive, who had opposed the British occupation, was out of the country when the war started. When the British declared the Protectorate on 18 December 1914 they deposed Abbas Hilmi and promoted Prince Hussein Kamel as the Sultan of Egypt.

fact: 1915年1月26日至2月4日，德方军官指挥的奥斯曼部队从南巴勒斯坦越过西奈半岛进攻苏伊士运河，少数人渡过了运河，进攻被英印部队与运河上的英法军舰击退。奥斯曼一方损失约1500人（含约700名俘虏），英方32人阵亡、130人受伤。这是西奈—巴勒斯坦战役的开端。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Raid on the Suez Canal
sources.quote: The raid on the Suez Canal, also known as actions on the Suez Canal, took place between 26 January and 4 February 1915 when a German-led Ottoman force advanced from southern Palestine to attack the British Empire-protected Suez Canal, marking the beginning of the Sinai and Palestine campaign (1915–1918) of World War I (1914–1918). Substantial Ottoman forces crossed the Sinai Peninsula, and a few managed to cross the Canal. ... The Ottoman attack was a failure with the loss of nearly 2,000 troops.

sources.title: Military History Wiki, Raid on the Suez Canal（战损表）
sources.quote: Date 26 January – 4 February 1915 ... Result: British victory ... Casualties and losses: 32 killed, 130 wounded; 1,500 casualties (including ~700 prisoners)

fact: 1915年下半年，埃及西部沙漠爆发塞努西战役；除此之外，1915年埃及境内没有其他大规模军事行动。全年埃及的主要角色是地中海远征军的后方基地：部队与补给经埃及转运至加里波利，伤病员送回埃及医院。

sources.title: Away from the Western Front, Egypt
sources.quote: Apart from the Senussi Campaign in the Western Desert later in the year, the rest of 1915 passed without military action in Egypt. The country had become the Base for the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force (MEF), fighting at Gallipoli. Troops, and particularly supplies were transited through Egypt before being sent to the MEF, and sick and wounded men came back to recover in Egyptian hospitals.

fact: 1914年11月2日起埃及处于戒严状态，军事当局可管制出版物、集会与人员流动；1914年8月2日当局已禁止必需品出口并实施价格管制。埃及人不是英国臣民，不被英国征兵法征召，但会以「志愿」名义被招募进劳工队与运输队；1915年英国为扩大小麦与稻米种植面积，强制限制棉花种植面积。

sources.title: V. B. Lutsky, Modern History of the Arab Countries, ch. 27（Marxists Internet Archive 全文）
sources.quote: On August 2, 1914, the authorities forbade the export of essential goods and introduced control over prices. ... In 1915, they forcibly restricted the area under cotton to expand the area under wheat and rice. The cotton plantations were reduced from 1,755,000 feddans in 1914 to 1,186,000 feddans in 1915.

sources.title: Away from the Western Front, Egypt
sources.quote: On 2 November, the British declared Martial Law in Egypt, where troops had already begun pouring in to defend the country and the Canal.

fact: 1914年战争爆发时埃及棉花价格下跌三分之一，政府宣布全面延期支付、把埃及国家银行纸币定为法定且不可兑换；到1915年底棉花价格回升至战前水平。1915年棉花种植面积被强制从1914年的175.5万费丹压缩到118.6万费丹以扩种小麦与稻米，粮价随军需与驻军需求上涨。棉花价格从1913年的每坎塔尔14里亚尔涨到1917年的38里亚尔。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922, Egypt（EB1922, Vol. 30, p. 940，Wikisource 全文）
sources.quote: The price of cotton fell by a third and a panic was averted only by drastic measures taken by the Government. As part of these measures a general moratorium was proclaimed and an emergency currency obtained by making the notes of the National Bank of Egypt temporarily legal tender and inconvertible. But cotton, stimulated by war demands, had again risen to pre-war prices by the end of 1915

sources.title: V. B. Lutsky, Modern History of the Arab Countries, ch. 27
sources.quote: In 1915, they forcibly restricted the area under cotton to expand the area under wheat and rice. The cotton plantations were reduced from 1,755,000 feddans in 1914 to 1,186,000 feddans in 1915. ... Cotton production soared again and cotton prices almost trebled: from 14 reals a cantar in 1913 to 38 reals a cantar in 1917.

fact: 1914年战争爆发后埃及随即宣布延期支付，埃及国家银行纸币被定为法定货币且不可兑换黄金；1916年10月纸币的黄金准备被撤销，改以英国国库券与英镑纸币为准备，埃及镑由此实际盯住英镑。同一时期，埃及的对外贸易顺差大量转为对英国战争公债与国库券的投资。

sources.title: V. B. Lutsky, Modern History of the Arab Countries, ch. 27
sources.quote: On August 2, 1914, the British authorities stopped the exchange of bank notes issued by the National Bank of Egypt for gold and forcibly introduced paper money. The National Bank's gold reserves were handed over to the British Treasury. ... In October 1916, the gold backing of Egyptian bank notes was withdrawn and instead they were backed by British Treasury bonds and pound sterling notes. The Egyptian pound was thus made dependent on the British pound

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1922, Egypt（EB1922, Vol. 30, p. 940）
sources.quote: a general moratorium was proclaimed and an emergency currency obtained by making the notes of the National Bank of Egypt temporarily legal tender and inconvertible.

fact: 苏伊士运河全长约100英里，沿线有铁路贯通，淡水从西岸供应，东岸只有咸水井。1915年1月前，英方以工程手段加强防御：1914年11月25日掘开塞得港的运河堤岸，引水淹没东岸沙漠，使北段防线缩短约20英里；1915年1月2日又在坎塔拉以北掘开亚洲岸堤，使坎塔拉至伊斯梅利亚之间形成浅水障碍。防御分为苏伊士—苦湖、德韦尔索瓦尔—费尔丹、费尔丹—塞得港三个防区。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Raid on the Suez Canal
sources.quote: The 100 miles (160 km) long canal had a railway running along its whole length and was supplied with water from the west, as only brackish wells could be found to the east. ... On 25 November, cutting the canal bank at Port Said flooded a portion of the desert stretching to El Kab, shortening the northern stretch of the canal by 20 miles (32 km). On 2 January, another major cutting in the Asiatic bank north of Qantara enabled minor inundations between Qantara and Ismailia.

fact: 1915年埃及成为地中海远征军的后方基地：部队、补给经埃及转运至加里波利，伤病员送回埃及医院；驻埃英军规模达27.5万人。为维持基地，英方保证铁路、供水、照明、排污与数千台灌溉泵所需的煤炭进口，并保护海上航线，使埃及港口货运量大增。有研究估计1916—1919年外部流入埃及的资金约1.5亿埃及镑。

sources.title: Away from the Western Front, Egypt
sources.quote: The country had become the Base for the Mediterranean Expeditionary Force (MEF), fighting at Gallipoli. Troops, and particularly supplies were transited through Egypt before being sent to the MEF, and sick and wounded men came back to recover in Egyptian hospitals.

sources.title: British Policy in Egypt during the Period of the Protectorate 1914-1922（AUB 硕士论文，引 Crouchley）
sources.quote: The increased revenue from cotton was supplemented by large sums of money spent in Egypt by Imperial and French forces during the Dardanelles and Palestine campaigns. It has been estimated that in the period 1916-1919 Egypt's total wealth increased from outside sources by £E150,000,000.
